# ledger_user (Data Source)

Reads one Ledger user by identifier or by username. User routes need an API token with the `users:read` and `users:write` grants. Creating or promoting an administrator, re-enabling a disabled administrator, and changing the root (first) account need the **root token** of the root account; any other token is refused with `root_token_required`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# By username (or by id).
data "ledger_user" "owner" {
  username = "alex"
}

output "owner_role" {
  value = data.ledger_user.owner.role
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The Ledger identifier. Set `id` or `username`, not both.
- `username` (String) The exact sign-in name. Disabled users are found too. Set `id` or `username`, not both.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the user is disabled.
- `disabled_at` (String) When it was disabled (RFC 3339, UTC), or null.
- `display_name` (String) The display name, or null.
- `role` (String) `administrator` or `read-only`.
- `updated_at` (String) When it last changed (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `version` (Number) The optimistic-concurrency version.
